title: Embedding quality shadow-run and signalization for config/model changes
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: We need a robust, low-cost offline signalization pipeline that runs whenever model or embedding config changes are proposed so product teams get deterministic quality regressions (recall@k, precision@k, MRR) and drift indicators before rollout. Current eval runs are ad-hoc, slow, and produce noisy single-number diffs that don't explain root cause across cohorts or prompt families.

Goal: Implement a "shadow-run" offline harness that: 1) replays representative request traces against both baseline and candidate embedding+reranker configs; 2) computes cohorted metrics (recall@1/5/10, precision@1/5, MRR, pairwise reranker AUC) and distributional drift tests (KS for distances, population z-scores, embedding L2 median shifts); 3) produces a signalization scorecard and tiered alert (info/warn/fail) with recommended rollback gates; 4) stores per-run artifacts (sampled queries, top-k results, diffs) for inspection in the console.

Non-goals: This ticket does not implement streaming real-time alerts or on-path canary routing. It focuses on offline pre-rollout evaluation and deterministic gating tied to config changes in the model config service.

Key deliverables:
- Shadow-run harness (replay + metric computation) as a service triggered by model/config PRs.
- A small set of cohort selectors: "heavy-tail queries", "short prompts", "enterprise-legal", and randomized sample.
- Baseline vs candidate run artifacts stored in S3 with stable names and a JSON scorecard.
- Signal thresholds tuned from historical runs and exposed as per-project overrideable profiles.
- CI hook + GitHub status + a Console link that shows card and diffs.

Trade-offs and decisions:
- Cost vs fidelity: we will sample <=10k queries per run to keep GPU/CPU cost manageable and to make runs finish in ~20–30 minutes. This keeps statistical power for medium-impact regressions while bounding infra spend.
- Metrics selection: prefer a small orthogonal set (recall@k, precision@k, MRR, KS on embedding distances). For reranker-specific artifacts we compute pairwise preference delta and NDCG on labeled buckets.
- Thresholding strategy: start with conservative z-score + absolute delta gates (example: recall@10 drop > 1.5% AND z-score < -2 => FAIL). Thresholds will be configurable by project after initial calibration.

Observability and follow-ups:
- Add a runtime job to record baseline historical variance per-cohort.
- Dashboard panel in Console: run history, run duration, cost estimate, failing cohorts.
- Auto-generate troubleshooting suggestions (e.g., "candidate quantized to 4-bit: check kernel compatibility and OOM warnings").
